created: before any R4 point was run

P1_reach.statement: the apparatus stays valid (all physics gates) at least 0.5 decade below the R3 floor kappa = 361.7, i.e. at kappa <= 114, and the first kappa that fails a gate is reported with the failing gate
P1_reach.rule: PASS if >= 1 gated point with kappa <= 361.7/10**0.5; PARTIAL if >= 1 gated point below 361.7; else NOT_SUPPORTED (write down the wall)

P2_inertial.statement: as kappa falls the local exponent n = 2(1-beta) rises monotonically and reaches >= 0.5 at the deepest gated pair (inertial leg at least half the stress, edit: Bagnold n=2 is the ceiling)
P2_inertial.rule: PASS if n rises monotonically over the sub-R3 pairs AND n_deepest >= 0.5; PARTIAL if monotone but n_deepest >= 0.3; else NOT_SUPPORTED

P3_partition.statement: the two-leg model tau* = A kappa + B beats the single power law at equal parameter count (delta AIC < 0) and recovers the elastic coefficient A within 15 % of R3's stiff-rung value
P3_partition.rule: PASS if delta_aic < -2 AND |A/A_R3 - 1| <= 0.15; PARTIAL if only one leg; else NOT_SUPPORTED

P4_boundary.statement: the fitted crossover kappa_x = B/A is consistent with Campbell's map boundary kappa_c ~ 1e4 (R2 ledger row, order of magnitude)
P4_boundary.rule: PASS if kappa_x within a factor 3 of 1e4; PARTIAL within a factor 10; else NOT_SUPPORTED (report the measured kappa_x, do not move the target)

P5_kinetic_crosscheck.statement: the fitted inertial fraction c/(kappa+c) is not orders of magnitude above the kinetic stress share measured at the same point: the leg is collisional if the ratio (measured/model) stays within [0.1, 10]
P5_kinetic_crosscheck.rule: kinetic_consistent if every ratio >= 0.1; contact_rate_dependent otherwise (a re-labelling of B, not a fit failure); not_run if no kinetic share

non_predictions.bagnold_coefficient: B is our own measured Bagnold prefactor; Bagnold (1954) / Campbell (2002) table values are not accessible from this sandbox, so the coefficient leg remains WITHHELD rather than reconstructed.
non_predictions.geometry: 2-D disks; Campbell's map is 3-D (declared deviation, unchanged from R1-R3).
non_predictions.kappa_definition: kappa uses the number-average diameter d = 1.2 with rho = 1; a different d (e.g. Sauter) rescales kappa by (d/d')^3 and hence moves the crossover by the same factor -- stated, not fitted away.
